text: Kuno National Park is a national park and wildlife sanctuary in the Gwalior Chambal region of Madhya Pradesh, India. It derives its name from the Kuno River. It was established in 1981 as a wildlife sanctuary with an initial area of 344.686 km2 (133.084 sq mi). In 2018, it was given the status of a national park with total area of 748.76 km2 (289.10 sq mi). The national park is the first site for the African cheetah translocation to India named Project Cheetah.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
